{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of severity
table_severity = data['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print(table_severity)

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")

# Check sample_seq for retested patients
max_sample_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
retested_count = (max_sample_seq > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (retested): {retested_count}")"}
